FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.NAME: Preflight validation
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.RETRYABLE: Read-only validation; STOP until time/window/watchdog and complete inputs separately close
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.OPERATION: Verify immutable deployment approval, frozen domain allocation/source fingerprint, exact four login slots, version-pinned policy/history/ACL and 37 closed header contracts. Recovery disposition for previous roots must be proven first. No operational READY.

FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.NAME: Final identity allocation
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.DURABLE_WRITE: NO DB write; existing nonsecret immutable ceremony-input custody
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.RETRYABLE: Never regenerate a subset. Before effects only an exact still-running preparation can retain the entire root. Failed preparation is abandoned before a new complete set.
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.AUTHORITY_CHANGE: NONE; reservations do not issue credentials or grants
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.OPERATION: Use prior FINAL_CEREMONY_IDENTITY_ALLOCATION: ten independent identities plus existing governed manifest/correlation and signer allocations. Freeze public scope/IDs before effects; no extra recovery/attempt UUID.

FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.NAME: Ephemeral signer preparation and staged canonical governance
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.DURABLE_WRITE: Two uncommitted V040 public rows inside T_REG only
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.SECRET_EXISTS: One process-local signer private key until E; public SPKI/lineage only in DB
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.RETRYABLE: Abort uncommitted root as a unit; any possibly committed write requires authoritative query
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.AUTHORITY_CHANGE: ACTIVE key + ENABLED bounded authority staged; become durable only with entire registration
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.COMMIT_BOUNDARY: T_REG shared with F; no C-only commit
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.OPERATION: After A/B and future temporal closure, BEGIN T_REG on the existing trusted ADMIN connection; immediately acquire existing organization/key/authority-scope locks in canonical order before key generation or writes. Obtain approved DB clock inputs, generate one ephemeral Ed25519 key, validate public SPKI and independently governed bounded authority; call existing V040 canonical append functions on that same connection (locks are reentrant). Save public semantic inputs in existing frozen ceremony-input context before first write. No calls to the separate-connection Kotlin convenience adapters.

FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.NAME: Manifest materialization
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.DURABLE_WRITE: NO additional durable effect; T_REG remains open
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.RETRYABLE: Abort/fresh entire root; no timestamp substitution or renewal
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.OPERATION: Encode exact existing 22-field ApprovalManifest and derived digest/preimage from actual allocated identities, source evidence and future-approved DB-derived window. Timestamp mapping is not selected by this gate.

FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.NAME: One signature and independent local verification
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.DURABLE_WRITE: NO additional DB effect; retain public original only in existing ceremony-input context
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.SECRET_EXISTS: Signer private key through single SIGN; destroy before F after local verification completes
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.RETRYABLE: Failed ceremony signature reuse DENY. Public verification/reconciliation needs no private key.
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.AUTHORITY_CHANGE: NONE; local JCA validity is not V041 acceptance
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.OPERATION: Sign exactly once in memory; independently verify canonical preimage, approved scope and public SPKI with JCA; retain exact public original and commitments; immediately destroy/release signer-private buffers in finally. Fail closed if custody cannot be bounded. Do not call V041 trusted-verifier/consumer or V043 operational wrappers.

FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.NAME: Complete registration and one atomic commit
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.DURABLE_WRITE: Exactly 11 newly staged rows: 2 V040 + 9 V043
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.SECRET_EXISTS: NO signer private key; separate governed ADMIN preflight-HMAC key domain remains subject to its existing custody contract
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.RETRYABLE: COMMIT outcome unknown -> QUERY_FIRST. Exact committed root -> return exact existing state. Confirmed rollback -> abandon/fresh.
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.AUTHORITY_CHANGE: T_REG makes bounded public signer governance and REGISTERED non-operational binding durable together; no command authority or admission
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.OPERATION: Within the already-open same transaction: complete fresh NOT_READY/readiness + preflight-key rows; complete 40-field header first; exact original expected attestation second; five lifecycle/control rows; explicitly verify complete 11-row write set and exact approved inputs; SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE; fresh DB window check under future time contract; COMMIT once. No missing control rows, UPSERT, placeholder, accepted evidence, commands, sessions or READY.

FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.NAME: Post-commit reconciliation and terminal governance closure
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.DURABLE_WRITE: T_CLOSE: one existing-governance append transaction only at independently proven terminal event
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.SECRET_EXISTS: NO signer private key; normal continuation already destroyed it at E
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.RETRYABLE: QUERY_FIRST on every unknown T_CLOSE outcome; already exact DISABLED/RETIRED -> no-op
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.AUTHORITY_CHANGE: DISABLED successor then RETIRED key successor; never reactivate or rewrite history
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.COMMIT_BOUNDARY: T_CLOSE: ONE conditional/later boundary, separate from registration
FINAL_CEREMONY_PHASES.OPERATION: Return exact durable registration after query, preserving NOT_READY. Do not retire immediately if later independently authorized V041/V042 effects remain pending. At final authorized effect/admission-consumption COMMIT, or proven abort/expiry/abandonment, existing ADMIN performs public-only terminal cleanup and verifies denial. No indefinite ENABLED orphan; on restart/next preparation reconcile outstanding roots before any signing or admission.

commit_boundary_counts.count_scope: A-G registration plus eventual terminal signer closure; no later operational verifier/issuance/decision transactions included in this registration-only design
commit_boundary_counts.read_only_query_transactions: End normally without durable writes; not counted as mutation boundaries
commit_boundary_counts.external_terminal_dependencies: Later V041 acceptance, V042 principal/credential/grant/decision, V043 consumption/delivery/reconciliation have independently guarded commits and existing receipts. They are not authorized here and cannot be included silently in T_REG or inferred complete. Q15-Q26 detect them; terminal cleanup waits for their independently proven end.

DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.WHY_SEPARATE_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED: No separate signer precommit is required. All 11 rows share one trusted ADMIN caller transaction. Existing immutable deadline policy/deployment/domain approvals are prerequisites, not new commits.
DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.CAN_MERGE_WITH_NEXT: NO: T_CLOSE must preserve an authorized interval for later V041/V042 mutations; immediate retirement would deny those effects.
DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.AUTHORITY: EXISTING_TRUSTED_REVIEWED_ADMIN / PLAN_BINDING_ADMIN; existing approval-governance capability for canonical V040 appends
DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.RECOVERY_QUERY: Q1-Q26 plus exact public canonical predicates after original writer is quiescent; see ambiguous-commit artifact

OBJECTS_COMMITTED: DISABLED signer authority successor when authority exists
RETIRED signer key successor when key remains ACTIVE
DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.WHY_SEPARATE_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED: After positive registration, retirement must wait for terminal authorized effect or independently classified abort/expiry. For legacy orphan cleanup it follows proven absence of binding/effects. This is existing governance, not a new recovery ledger.
DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.CAN_MERGE_WITH_NEXT: No additional closure boundary. Disable and retire share one transaction, except already terminal rows are no-ops.
DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.AUTHORITY: EXISTING_TRUSTED_REVIEWED_ADMIN / PLAN_BINDING_ADMIN; existing approval-governance capability for canonical V040 appends
DURABLE_COMMIT_BOUNDARIES.RECOVERY_QUERY: Q13-Q14 lineage/effective-state inspection plus full root query. A lost cleanup acknowledgment is queried before appending any successor.

precommit_proof.selected_path: Local JCA signature verification using exact planned public SPKI/canonical scope; expected-original V043 registration, not durable V041 acceptance. Existing V040 functions have no internal COMMIT and can share T_REG with complete V043 provisioning.
precommit_proof.dedicated_V041_adapter_alternative: YES for committed visibility when using PostgresAcceptedAttestationVerifier on its separate DataSource connection before binding: V041 begin reads effective ACTIVE public key and current ENABLED authority. That pre-acceptance adds a durable accepted row and is excluded from registration-only path.
precommit_proof.existing_Kotlin_adapter_limit: PostgresApprovalGovernance.transact owns a connection and commits EACH append. Two existing method calls cannot be labeled one T_REG. Same-connection composition of the existing canonical SQL functions is the selected future design; no application composer has been implemented, executed or runtime-qualified here.
precommit_proof.no_authority_shortcut: Local verification cannot create s2a_accepted_attestation or replace its later dedicated verifier. Trusted ADMIN may provision existing reviewed header/original records without new role/ACL/schema.
